snippet.title: TEASER | THE FATUM
snippet.description:
You are an investigator, an agent of the civil service, sent to a new sector to investigate cases of infection. You will have to analyze the evidence, interrogate the residents and make morally difficult decisions on which their fate depends. But the deeper you dive into the investigation, the more you realize that the danger comes not only from the virus...

The visual is based on the PS1(X) style. The game is being developed by a small indie team using the Unity engine.

As early as June 2025, you will be able to try out our game at the Steam Fest.: "There must be games!"
